title: The Sorceress Below
intro: A generated dungeon. The sorceress Vexa rules from the deepest room; her goblins guard the halls.

agents.personality: Vexa, a sorceress who rules this dungeon from her throne. She is bored and curious about visitors.
Grub, a lazy goblin. Loves shiny things.
Snik, a nervous goblin who talks too much.
